description: This file defines the Address controller class for the Opencart e-commerce platform's account address management. It contains methods for displaying and managing user addresses, including listing, editing, and adding addresses, with associated view rendering and URL routing.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Controller class for handling user address operations within the Opencart account module, including listing, editing, and adding addresses.

methods.description: Handles the address list request, including authentication checks and returning the list view.

methods.description: Retrieves the list of user addresses and formats them for display.
